points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 海顿出生于奥地利罗劳的一个车轮制造家庭，是家中十二个孩子中的第二个。尽管家境贫寒，但他的音乐天赋很早就被发现。当地教堂的唱诗班指挥注意到海顿的嗓音条件，推荐他前往维也纳接受音乐教育。这段乡村生活虽然简朴，但海顿后来回忆说，他的父母虽然贫穷，却非常善良，给了他快乐的童年，这对他后来的乐观性格产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Haydn was born in Rohrau, Austria, into a family of wheelwrights. Despite their poverty, his parents recognized his musical talent early. The local church choir director noticed Haydn's vocal abilities and recommended him for musical education in Vienna. This rural childhood, though simple, shaped Haydn's optimistic personality. He later recalled that though his parents were poor, they were very kind and gave him a happy childhood, which profoundly influenced his later character.

points.title: 学徒与自由音乐家
points.description: 1740年，8岁的海顿离开家乡，在维也纳圣斯蒂芬大教堂的唱诗班担任童声歌手，接受严格的音乐训练。变声期后，他一度陷入贫困，靠教学和演奏为生。这一时期，海顿勤奋学习，自学作曲，并结识了意大利作曲家波尔波拉，成为其助手和声乐学生。1750年代，海顿逐渐在维也纳音乐界崭露头角，创作了第一批弦乐四重奏和交响乐作品，为后来的音乐生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1740, at age 8, Haydn left his hometown to join the choir of St. Stephen's Cathedral in Vienna, where he received rigorous musical training. After his voice changed, he faced poverty and made a living by teaching and performing. During this period, Haydn diligently studied composition independently and studied with Italian composer Nicola Porpora, becoming his assistant and vocal student. In the 1750s, Haydn gradually gained recognition in Vienna's music scene, composing his first string quartets and symphonies, laying the foundation for his future career.

points.title: 埃斯特哈齐宫廷乐长
points.description: 1761年，海顿受聘为匈牙利贵族埃斯特哈齐亲王的副乐长，1790年升任首席乐长。在这近30年的宫廷生活中，海顿负责亲王宫廷的全部音乐事务，包括创作、演奏和管理。这一时期是他创作的黄金时代，创作了104部交响曲（包括著名的'告别交响曲'）、68部弦乐四重奏、钢琴奏鸣曲以及大量宗教音乐。埃斯特哈齐宫廷提供了稳定的工作环境和创作自由，使海顿能够发展出独特的音乐风格，奠定了'交响乐之父'的地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1761, Haydn was hired as Vice-Kapellmeister to Hungarian Prince Paul Anton Esterházy, becoming full Kapellmeister in 1766. During these nearly 30 years at court, Haydn was responsible for all musical affairs, including composition, performance, and management. This period was his golden age of composition, producing 104 symphonies (including the famous 'Farewell Symphony'), 68 string quartets, piano sonatas, and numerous religious works. The Esterházy court provided stability and creative freedom, allowing Haydn to develop his unique musical style and earn the title 'Father of the Symphony'.

points.title: 首次伦敦之旅
points.description: 1791年，海顿接受英国音乐赞助人约翰·萨尔曼的邀请，首次访问伦敦。这次访问持续了18个月，海顿创作了著名的'伦敦交响曲'（第93至98号），并在伦敦多次公开演出，获得了巨大成功。海顿对英国的音乐生活和听众印象深刻，英国听众对海顿音乐的热爱也让他备受鼓舞。这次伦敦之旅不仅为海顿带来了经济上的成功，也拓展了他的音乐视野，使他接触到新的音乐风格和演奏传统，对他的后期创作产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1791, Haydn accepted an invitation from British music impresario Johann Peter Salomon to visit London for the first time. This 18-month visit saw him compose his famous 'London Symphonies' (Nos. 93-98) and give numerous public concerts, achieving great success. Haydn was impressed by British musical life and audiences, and their enthusiasm for his music was deeply encouraging. This London tour brought Haydn financial success and broadened his musical horizons, exposing him to new musical styles and performance traditions that profoundly influenced his later compositions.

points.title: 晚年创作与遗产
points.description: 1794年，海顿再次访问伦敦后回到维也纳，虽然不再担任正式职务，但继续创作。这一时期，他创作了最后六部'伦敦交响曲'、两部清唱剧《创世纪》和《四季》，以及晚期弦乐四重奏。海顿晚年备受尊敬，经常接待年轻音乐家如贝多芬和莫扎特。1809年，拿破仑军队占领维也纳期间，海顿在病榻上逝世，享年77岁。海顿一生创作了104部交响曲、68部弦乐四重奏、14部弥撒曲以及大量其他作品，被誉为'交响乐之父'和'弦乐四重奏之父'，对古典音乐的发展产生了不可估量的影响。
points.descriptionEn: After his second London visit in 1794, Haydn returned to Vienna, where he continued composing without holding an official position. During this period, he wrote his last six 'London Symphonies', the oratorios 'The Creation' and 'The Seasons', and his late string quartets. In his later years, Haydn was highly respected and frequently hosted young musicians like Beethoven and Mozart. Haydn died in Vienna in 1809 at age 77, during Napoleon's occupation. He composed 104 symphonies, 68 string quartets, 14 masses, and numerous other works, earning the titles 'Father of the Symphony' and 'Father of the String Quartet,' leaving an immeasurable influence on the development of classical music.

appraisal.zh: 海顿被公认为「交响乐之父」和「弦乐四重奏之父」，他确立了两者的基本形式，发展奏鸣曲式并赋予各乐器平等地位，为莫扎特和贝多芬铺平了道路，其作品以结构的严谨与旋律的优美体现了古典主义的平衡与和谐。也有研究者指出，他的音乐有时过于保守和公式化，情感表达相对克制，长期服务于贵族宫廷也使创作受赞助人喜好所限，晚年作品的创新性有所减弱。但总体而言，他仍是古典主义音乐的关键奠基者。
appraisal.en: Haydn is widely recognized as the 'Father of the Symphony' and 'Father of the String Quartet,' establishing the basic forms of both, developing sonata form and giving equal weight to all instruments, thereby paving the way for Mozart and Beethoven; his works embody Classical balance and harmony through rigorous structure and graceful melody. Some researchers note that his music can be conservative and formulaic, emotionally restrained, that his long service to aristocratic courts constrained him by patrons' tastes, and that his late works showed diminished innovation. Overall, however, he remains a pivotal founder of Classical music.

supporter.zh: 海顿被誉为'交响乐之父'和'弦乐四重奏之父'，他的音乐作品结构严谨、旋律优美，体现了古典主义的平衡与和谐。海顿的创新精神，如在交响乐中发展奏鸣曲式、在弦乐四重奏中赋予各乐器平等地位，极大地影响了后世音乐发展。他的乐观开朗性格也反映在音乐中，为古典音乐注入了温暖与人性。海顿对音乐教育的贡献同样不可忽视，他培养了许多优秀音乐家，并通过作品展示了音乐创作的可能性。
supporter.en: Haydn is celebrated as the 'Father of the Symphony' and 'Father of the String Quartet.' His musical works, with their严谨 structure and beautiful melodies, embody the balance and harmony of Classicism. His innovative spirit, such as developing the sonata form in symphonies and giving equal importance to all instruments in string quartets, profoundly influenced later music development. His optimistic and cheerful personality is reflected in his music, infusing classical music with warmth and humanity. Haydn's contributions to music education are equally noteworthy, as he mentored many excellent musicians and demonstrated the possibilities of musical composition through his works.

critic.zh: 批评者认为海顿的作品有时过于保守和公式化，缺乏贝多芬那样的革命性突破。他的音乐虽然技巧精湛，但情感表达相对克制，被认为不够深刻。此外，海顿长期服务于贵族宫廷，其创作受到赞助人喜好的限制，可能缺乏真正的艺术独立性。一些评论家还指出，海顿晚年作品虽然成熟，但创新性有所减弱，未能完全跟上音乐发展的新趋势。
critic.en: Critics argue that Haydn's works can be overly conservative and formulaic, lacking the revolutionary breakthroughs of composers like Beethoven. While technically brilliant, his music is considered relatively restrained in emotional expression, perceived as less profound. Additionally, Haydn's long service to aristocratic courts limited his artistic independence, as his compositions were constrained by the preferences of his patrons. Some commentators also note that his late works, though mature, showed diminished innovation and failed to fully keep pace with emerging musical trends.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，海顿是古典主义音乐的关键人物，他确立了交响乐和弦乐四重奏的基本形式，为莫扎特和贝多芬铺平了道路。在流行文化中，海顿的形象常被塑造为'快乐的农夫'，体现了他朴实无华的性格和音乐风格。历史学界普遍认为，海顿的最大贡献在于他建立了古典音乐的形式规范，同时保持了音乐的自然流畅和情感表达。他的作品平衡了技巧与情感，理性与感性，成为古典主义美学的典范。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Haydn was a pivotal figure in Classical music who established the basic forms of the symphony and string quartet, paving the way for Mozart and Beethoven. In popular culture, Haydn is often portrayed as the 'happy peasant,' reflecting his unpretentious personality and musical style. Historians generally agree that Haydn's greatest contribution was establishing the formal conventions of classical music while maintaining natural flow and emotional expression. His works balance technique with emotion, and reason with sensibility, becoming exemplars of Classical aesthetics.

self.zh: 我的语言所有人都懂，我的音乐必须触动人心，而不是仅仅满足耳朵。
self.en: My language is understood by everyone; my music must touch the heart, not merely please the ear.
